goal: Add express/standard order priority and backorder recording across the existing domain, application and API. priority accepts only standard or express, defaults to standard when omitted, and rejects other values with a priority error. An order that exceeds available stock must remain cancellable, record a positive backorder, emit exactly one application event of type backorder-recorded, and be observable through currentOrders(), currentBackorders(), and events(). currentBackorders() entries must be exactly { orderId, skuId, missing }. Preserve existing behavior. Add focused tests beside modified code.
acceptanceCriteria: priority accepts only standard or express, defaults to standard when omitted, and invalid values fail with an error that names priority.
Insufficient stock leaves the order cancellable and records a positive backorder with exact { orderId, skuId, missing } data.
The application emits exactly one backorder-recorded event for each backorder and preserves non-backorder behavior.
The API exposes currentOrders(), currentBackorders(), and events(), with currentBackorders entries shaped exactly as { orderId, skuId, missing }.
